content.title: World Suspension | Active Freeze, Mobile Exception, One Global Resumption
content.summary: Establish a populated moving environment before one attributable action suspends distributed motion across people, loose objects, and ambient activity. Keep one clearly defined protagonist as the mobile exception, prove the frozen state through several readable interactions, and restore the whole space once through a visible release cue.

quick_start.input_format: populated moving baseline + attributable freeze trigger + distributed suspended motion + one mobile adult exception + multiple frozen-state proofs + single global resumption
quick_start.recommended_input: A clearly adult transit inspector crosses a bright indoor ferry terminal while commuters, rolling luggage, paper tickets, and a flock of small cleaning drones move normally. One press on a brass stopwatch suspends every other motion; the inspector walks between a hovering ticket and a tilted suitcase, adjusts one route marker, then clicks the watch shut. All suspended motion resumes together and the inspector continues toward the same gate.
required_anchors: Show at least three independent environmental motion classes before suspension.
Use one visible trigger and keep one adult carrier as the only mobile exception.
Allow at most one restrained observation without locally restarting the world.
Resume distributed motion only once near the end and continue the carrier route.
usage_steps: Replace the example subject, setting, and surface details with an original concept.
Keep every required anchor and Creative DNA invariant causally visible.
Choose the MiniMax H3 or Seedance 2.0 prompt and fill only the declared variable slots.
Check duration, event order, camera continuity, sound, and anti-copy constraints before generation.
applicable_scope: Establish a populated moving environment before one attributable action suspends distributed motion across people, loose objects, and ambient activity. Keep one clearly defined protagonist as the mobile exception, prove the frozen state through several readable interactions, and restore the whole space once through a visible release cue.
Original 4–15 second concepts that can preserve every required anchor.
MiniMax H3 or Seedance 2.0 projects that need a reusable causal video structure.
not_suitable_for: Requests that copy the source identity, setting, props, dialogue, or shot order.
Concepts that cannot show all required anchors inside the target duration.
Long-form exposition or unrelated multi-location stories without a compact causal chain.

creative_dna.mechanism: Establish one clearly adult carrier moving through a complex environment while at least three independent motion classes are visibly active. Use one attributable trigger to suspend all environmental motion while the carrier alone remains mobile. Continue past recurring frozen anchors, permit at most one restrained observation, then use one terminal trigger to resume distributed motion across the same geography and continue the route. The reusable mechanism is active baseline, global suspension, single mobile exception, sustained comparison and one terminal resumption—not the source woman, clothing, city, pigeons, red dress, snap design, white shockwave, exact interaction, camera route, watermark or prompt wording.

invariants.rule: Show at least three independent environmental motion classes before suspension.
invariants.purpose: Makes the global stop visually provable.
invariants.ablation_failure: A mostly static baseline cannot demonstrate a state change.

invariants.rule: Use one visible trigger and keep one adult carrier as the only mobile exception.
invariants.purpose: Provides clear causal ownership and comparison.
invariants.ablation_failure: Multiple mobile exceptions or an unseen trigger weaken the rule.

invariants.rule: Preserve recurring frozen anchors while the carrier continues through the same geography.
invariants.purpose: Sustains the shared suspended state over time.
invariants.ablation_failure: Changing location or replacing anchors turns the effect into montage.

invariants.rule: Allow at most one restrained observation without locally restarting the world.
invariants.purpose: Adds relationship evidence while preserving the global rule.
invariants.ablation_failure: Repeated touching or partial restarts create unrelated sub-events.

invariants.rule: Resume distributed motion only once near the end and continue the carrier route.
invariants.purpose: Closes the state interval with a verifiable terminal transition.
invariants.ablation_failure: Multiple resumptions or a static ending leave the rule ambiguous.

slots.name: lead_subject
slots.constraint: An original stable subject or pair with a readable role.

slots.name: setting
slots.constraint: A new setting with fixed spatial anchors and no source-specific surface.

slots.name: escalation_variable
slots.constraint: One causal variable that changes through visible stages.

slots.name: performance_rule
slots.constraint: A restrained acting or motion rule that keeps the mechanism legible.

slots.name: camera_grammar
slots.constraint: An information order that proves each state without copying source shot boundaries.

slots.name: payoff
slots.constraint: A clean final physical, informational or social consequence.

slots.name: sound_family
slots.constraint: An original hierarchy of diegetic cues; no unsupported source-audio claim.

anti_copy_exclusions: the source woman, face, hair, leather jacket, backpack, body presentation and exact performance
the source city plaza, buildings, pedestrians, pigeons, leaves, dust and red flowing dress
the source finger snaps, white spherical shockwave, frozen poses, near-touch and restoration choreography
the source camera track, aerial pullback, daylight grade, timing and terminal fade
the source creator identity, watermark, platform overlay and exact same-post prompt wording
